notes: One model's raw forecast (Open-Meteo, no correction) summarised by the outlook's rules: Prague time, night 0-6, morning 6-12, afternoon 12-18, evening 18-24, day 0-24; precipitation and sunshine belong to the hour before their time; tmin/tmax, precipitation total (mm), highest hourly wind (m/s), mean cloud cover (%, a whole day: of 6-18), hours of sunshine. A period the model does not cover in full (beyond its horizon) is null. Symbol: rain (sleet, snow at a mean of <= 2 / <= 0.5 °C) when the model's own total is at least 0.3 mm, else the sky from its cloud cover (clear < 30 %, partly cloudy < 65 %, else cloudy); never showers. No probability of precipitation from one model (rain_probability null). Values per okres: one list per column, days x parts (index = day * 5 + part); symbol as its position in symbols.
